rationale_code: The server is an OpenAPI proxy onto api.notion.com authenticated with the operator's Notion integration token; `API-get-user` returns a workspace member record (name, email, avatar) that is private account data, so it pulls non-public data into the agent context. Lists every member of the authenticated workspace (`start_cursor`/`page_size` pagination), i.e. private directory data reached with the user's Notion credentials. Source was not included, so labelling is from the advertised operation and left undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line r

Returns the identity tied to the configured Notion token (bot user, owner, workspace name) — non-public information about the user's account/credential. No source lines available, so undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Searches all pages and data sources shared with the integration and returns their titles/objects — private workspace content. The request goes to the fixed Notion API endpoint, so it is not a SINK. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Reads the block content of a page in the user's workspace with the user's token, returning private data. Content originates in the user's own account, so UNTRUSTED is not raised. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Writes agent-supplied blocks into a page inside the user's own Notion workspace via the fixed api.notion.com endpoint. The destination is private account data, not an attacker-readable location, and no host code execution or credential read-back is involved, so no label. Marked undetermined because

Returns a single block's content from the user's workspace using the user's credential — non-public data into context. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Mutates/archives a block in the user's private workspace through the fixed vendor endpoint; destructive but not an attacker-readable destination and no secret read-back is the tool's purpose. Undetermined because no source lines were provided. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Deletes content in the user's own workspace via the fixed Notion endpoint — destructive, but no exfiltration channel, secret retrieval or host execution. Undetermined: source not supplied. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Returns page properties from the user's Notion workspace reached with the user's integration token — non-public data. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Updates properties of a page in the user's private workspace. The `cover`/`icon` fields accept an agent-chosen external URL, but the fetch would be performed by Notion's servers for an image, not a general agent-controlled request carrying data; kept unlabelled. Creates a page inside the user's own workspace via api.notion.com. Written content lands in private account data, not a public repo/issue/gist, so no SINK. Undetermined: no source lines were provided to confirm the request target. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Reads an individual property value from a private page using the user's credential — non-public data into the agent context. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Returns comment threads on a page: private workspace data (SECRET). Comment threads are a multi-writer surface — guests, external collaborators and other integrations can post into them, and comment bodies are returned verbatim to the agent — so attacker-controllable text can plausibly arrive here;

Posts agent-supplied text as a comment on a page in the user's own workspace. Unless that page is published to the web (not something this tool does), the destination is not attacker-readable, so no SINK. Returns the schema/title/description of a private Notion data source using the user's token — non-public data. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Creates a database under a page in the user's own workspace — a private write target, so no SINK. Undetermined because the server source was not included. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Lists template pages belonging to a private database, returning workspace content reached with the user's credential. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]
Returns a private database object (title, data sources, parent) from the user's workspace. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Re-parents a page within the user's own workspace via the fixed Notion API; destructive but no exfiltration path, secret read-back or host execution. Undetermined: no source lines supplied. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]

Dumps the full content of a private Notion page (optionally including meeting-note transcripts) into the agent context using the user's integration token — clearly non-public data. Source not provided; undetermined. [unverified: no citation with a file:line reference]
